# PanduAGENT Phase 2

> 2,222 new street animals on BNB Chain — new outfits, new friends of Pandu. First mint FREE for Agent ID holders; paid mints open to everyone; 5-pack 0.0108 BNB.

- Mint page: https://panduagent-phase2.vercel.app/
- Market: https://panduagent-phase2.vercel.app/market.html
- Agent skill: https://panduagent-phase2.vercel.app/agent-skill.md

## Spec

- Chain: BNB Smart Chain (56), BEP-721, sequential IDs 1–2,222
- Supply: 2,222 — Common 1–1,111 (Hoodie Panda / Cap Fox), Uncommon 1,112–1,666 (Bomber Cat / Tracksuit Dog), Rare 1,667–1,999 (Raincoat Frog / Puffer Penguin), Epic 2,000–2,154 (Cyber Panda v2 / Kimono Fox), Legendary 2,155–2,222 (Golden Panda / Shadow Fox)
- Mint: #1 FREE (Agent ID only, via agent), #2 0.00126 BNB, #3 0.00316 BNB, #4 0.0041 BNB, #5 0.005 BNB (public, wallet); max 5 per wallet (1 free + 4 paid)
- 5-pack: mintPack5() — 5 animals in one tx for a flat 0.0108 BNB (20% off 0.01352, save 0.00272 BNB); requires 0 prior mints; agent pack = 1 free + 4 paid, public pack = 5 paid; accrues 480,000 PNDX either way
- Gate: FREE mint — Binance Agentic Wallet + SPACE ID .ai Agent ID (on-chain check). Paid mints — public, no Agent ID needed, flat BNB.
- Royalty: 5%. Revenue forwards to owner wallet in-tx.
- Token: PNDX (reused from Phase 1, already deployed) — 120,000 per paid mint, 1B total (540M pool / 460M treasury), max 480,000 per wallet. No price, no liquidity yet.
- Market: fixed-price escrow, 0% platform fee, 5% creator royalty. Element Market after deploy.
- Live status: animated growing bamboo — the stalk grows taller and sprouts leaves as mints rise.

## Status

Preview. Contracts are predicted, not deployed. Mint is not open yet. Phase 1 (0x4AB41152EdB3E2853b19828e51927db36508cd64) is sold out — do not mint there.
